last.verdict: Investors cheered faster backlog growth, a raised outlook, and fading fears that AI hurts Salesforce.

reasons.label: Faster contracted growth
reasons.text: Backlog due within 12 months grew 14%, speeding up, with the same 14% guided for next quarter.

reasons.label: AI fears eased
reasons.text: AI products topped $1.5B in yearly sales, up over 240%, easing worries AI threatens Salesforce.

reasons.label: Raised outlook, cash surge
reasons.text: Full-year revenue forecast raised to $46.1–46.4B; free cash flow jumped 81% to $1.1B.

story: Salesforce has beaten profit estimates for several quarters, but stock reactions swung from a small gain in December to a drop after cautious guidance in February and May. Growth stuck near 11% and AI worries weighed until this report.
